purpose: Run a fresh, validation-only normalization-parity pilot for the seven core forecasting baselines used by the Mamba/AutoCon study.
research_question: Under one source snapshot, M-feature contract, MeanStd window normalization, optimizer, horizon, and seed set, how do DLinear, NLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, iTransformer, Mamba1, and Mamba2 compare on ETTh1, ETTm1, Electricity, and Traffic?
evidence_boundary: Exploratory pilot only. These short-budget validation rows are independent of native-normalization pilots, historical corrected tables, and confirmation artifacts.
claim_boundary: Report paired validation descriptions and implementation coverage only. This matrix cannot establish test-set ranking, universal Mamba accuracy, AutoCon gain, non-inferiority, or end-to-end speed.

seed_policy.artifact_policy: Use only the fresh output root. Retain source snapshot, environment record, dataset hashes, plan hash, config hashes, manifest, and validation trajectories. Test metrics are withheld.

phases.name: meanstd_core_baselines_h96
phases.purpose: Fresh same-provenance MeanStd baseline pilot; DLinear and NLinear use the newly added opt-in normalization path, while all other models use their existing MeanStd contract.

comparison_contract.interpretation: Use paired seed deltas within each dataset. Windows and channels are not independent replicates. Keep Mamba1 and Mamba2 as separate families.
comparison_contract.historical_comparison_rule: Do not append these rows to native-normalization, corrected, fair-screen, or high-dimensional historical tables. A publication matrix must rerun all intended baselines under one frozen source, normalization, optimizer, and test-release contract.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: This short validation-only pilot can identify implementation gaps and dataset-dependent patterns, but cannot support a final ranking, non-inferiority, universal accuracy, or speed claim.

resource_contract.prediction_only: Measure later on the same GPU with device-resident synthetic input, fixed warmup, synchronized p50/p95 latency, active/total parameters, and peak allocated/reserved memory.
resource_contract.train_step: Prediction-only resources are not a training-speed claim; a later resource phase must include identical forward, backward, optimizer, loader, and synchronization settings.
resource_contract.capacity_note: The Mamba rows use the repository-compatible forecasting head and are descriptive architecture baselines, not parameter-matched controls for every Transformer or linear model.

stopping_rules: Keep this matrix validation-only and withhold test metrics.
If a dataset hash, source snapshot, config hash, or phase artifact is missing or changed, stop rather than impute or copy a row.
Do not choose an architecture, normalization, horizon, or AutoCon follow-up from test data.
If a model fails shape, memory, or training, retain an explicit failed row and investigate; do not silently drop it from the denominator.
A favorable validation pattern requires a separately reviewed full-budget replication before any publication claim.
